records.name: Trap Shooter
records.mechanics: Bojack fires a tracking volley; additional input can cancel the move before release, while the fired volley produces a multi-hit barrage.

records.mechanics: Homing Ki Blasts can trigger a rapid follow-up barrage; guarding can cancel the follow-up.
